fixture.description: The diff masks the password in CheckoutRequest.toString(), but the unchanged sibling logRequest() in the same class still logs the raw password. The fix is incomplete: a sibling sink of the same secret remains.

grader.rubric: PASS if the report, at IMPORTANT or CRITICAL in the main body, flags that logRequest() in CheckoutRequest still writes the raw password to the log (CWE-532), even though that line is unchanged, because the diff's toString() masking fix is incomplete; ideally suggests masking or omitting it there too. FAIL if only the toString() change is praised or the unchanged sibling sink is not reported, or it is rated below IMPORTANT.

expected_behavior: Reviews the unchanged sibling logRequest() as part of the incomplete fix
Reports the remaining raw password log at IMPORTANT+
expected_not_behavior: Does NOT dismiss the sink as pre-existing/unchanged code out of scope
Does NOT flag the masked toString() as a defect
